title: [finding] the os-dev dispatch contract and the harness attribution reminder contradict each other on the commit trailer — and landed history follows the reminder
body:
A dispatched `os-dev` could not write its commit without first resolving a contradiction between
two instruction sources it is handed at the same time. It flagged the conflict instead of silently
siding with one, which is the right behaviour — and it will hit **every** dev dispatch until one of
the two texts moves.

## The contradiction, as the dev stated it

- The dispatch contract (`.claude/agents/os-dev.md`) says the commit trailer pair is **model-free**.
- The harness-injected attribution reminder names **`Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5`** verbatim, and
  says explicitly that it supersedes Claude Code's own earlier attribution guidance.
- The same shape repeats on the PR footer: the contract names the session-URL `_Generated by_` line;
  the harness reminder names the `Generated with Claude Code` block.

## The tiebreaker nobody wrote down: landed history already picked a side

Measured on `objectstack-ai/cloud` `origin/main`, 2026-09-17T15:30Z — recent landed commits
(`d6d6dda`, `66e3915`) carry the **model-bearing** spelling, and landed PR bodies carry **both**
footers, stacked. So the text that disagrees with what actually lands is the contract, not the
reminder.

## What the dispatching seat ruled for the one PR in hand

`objectstack-ai/cloud#2320` keeps the landed convention (the dev's option A). ⛔ Not because it was
already written: amending would make that branch's only commit differ from every neighbour on
`main`, trading consistency for a churn with no product value.

⇒ That ruling is **per-PR and does not fix anything**. The durable fix is one edit to whichever text
should move, and this card is where that decision belongs.

## Why this is filed rather than fixed

The contract lives on a governed surface (`.claude/**`). The `repo:cloud` seat ⛔ does not write
files, and a dev ⛔ does not edit its own dispatch contract inside its own dispatch. Handed to the
skills lane as a `finding` per 「原则错/缺 → skills 席专题」.

⚠️ Note for whoever takes it: the fix is **not** obviously "make the contract match the reminder".
The reminder is harness-injected and can change without a PR; a contract that merely restates it
will drift again. The durable shape may be for the contract to stop naming trailer text at all and
defer to whatever the harness supplies.

Found via `objectstack-ai/cloud#2305` / PR `objectstack-ai/cloud#2320`, dev report open_questions[0].
